name: C.Q. Pharmaceutical Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: C.Q. Pharmaceutical Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the wholesale and retail of medicines and medical devices. The company is involved in the pharmaceutical commerce, warehousing logistics, pharmaceutical industry, and research and development businesses. It also engages in the hospital pure sales, commercial wholesale, retail chain, warehousing logistics, and supply chain value-added services for drugs, medical devices, Chinese herbal medicines, and health products. The company was formerly known as Southwest Branch of China Medicine Company. C.Q. Pharmaceutical Holding Co., Ltd. was founded in 1999 and is based in Chongqing, China.
